event.title: New York State International Film Festival – October 2
event.description:
Join us October 2–3 at Steamer 10 Theatre for the 11th Annual New York State International Film Festival, a two-day celebration of independent filmmaking from around the world!

Doors open at 5:30 PM, with film screenings beginning at 6:00 PM each night. The festival will showcase a diverse selection of local, national, and international independent short films, bringing unique stories, creative voices, and talented filmmakers together for an exciting weekend of cinema.

In addition to the film screenings, audiences will have the opportunity to participate in Q&A panels with filmmakers, offering a behind-the-scenes look at the creative process and the stories behind the films.

The festival will also feature our Best Movies Award Ceremony, celebrating outstanding films and filmmakers selected from this year’s program.

We are proud to present the Brendan Fahy Bequette Fund Best Young Filmmaker Award, which includes a $500 cash prize to support and encourage the next generation of independent filmmakers.

Come experience two nights of great short films, meet filmmakers, participate in Q&A discussions, and celebrate independent cinema at the 11th Annual New York State International Film Festival!

event.title: LIZZIE (The Musical)
event.description:
Lizzie Borden took an ax
And gave her mother forty whacks,
And when she saw what she had done,
She gave her father forty-one.

Steamer No.10 Theatre’s Eclectic Performance Series for Adult Audiences

presents the CAPITAL REGION PREMIERE OF

LIZZIE (The Musical)

Music by Steven Cheslik-DeMeyer and Alan Stevens Hewitt
Lyrics by Steven Cheslik-DeMeyer and Tim Maner
Book by Tim Maner
Additional Music by Tim Maner
Additional Lyrics by Alan Stevens Hewitt
Based on an original concept by Steven Cheslik-DeMeyer and Tim Maner
Orchestrations by Alan Stevens Hewitt

DIRECTED & CHOREOGRAPHED BY KELLY SIENKIEWICZ

ASSISTANT DIRECTED & STAGED MANAGED BY MELANIE MAGRI

MUSIC DIRECTED BY JESS FITZSISTI

 

STARRING…

MEGAN MORSE as EMMA

KELLY SIENKIEWICZ as BRIDGET

EMILY JENKINS as ALICE

REGAN ZLOTNICK as LIZZIE

MELANIE MAGRI as SWING

Rage! Sex! Betrayal! Bloody murder! In the heat of late summer 1892, Andrew Borden and his wife are found murdered in their house. The main suspect? Andrew’s youngest daughter from a previous marriage: Lizzie Borden. This all-woman musical sets American mythology to a searing rock score – complete with riffs on the historical record – to explore the heady and heated days leading up to the historical murder and Lizzie’s controversial acquittal of all charges.

 

SHOW DATES & TIMES

FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 6 @ 7:00 PM

SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 7 @ 7:00 PM

SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 8 @ 3:00 PM

FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13 @ 7:00 PM

SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 14 @ 7:00 PM

SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 15 @ 3:00 PM

 

LIZZIE is presented by arrangement with Concord Theatricals.

event.title: CAST – Game of Tiaras
event.description:
From Don Zolidis – author of Brothers Grimm Spectaculathon

The aging king of a Magical Kingdom (England) decides to split his empire between his three daughters, Cinderella, Belle and the Snow Queen (who in no way resembles a copyrighted character), terrible tragedy ensues. Terrible, hilarious tragedy. Combining the gut-wrenching plot twists of Game of Thrones and the soul-numbing despair of Shakespearean tragedy, this adaptation of King Lear will leave you dying with laughter as the body count mounts. When you play the Game of Tiaras, you win or you die.
